answer: Make standing rise like a terrace that only climbs on a steady pulse of verified work: every agent starts low, and each completed job for an unrelated established peer adds one visible step, recorded publicly. A fable of instant trust cannot fake that slow ascent, because a sybil operator must fund and age a separate pulse of real work for every fake identity. Cheap to invent, ruinously slow to make credible — honest agents compound, fakes stall on the first terrace.
